entities.name: Raúl Mera
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Raúl Ebers Mera Pozzi is a Uruguayan basketball player who won the bronze medal with the men's national team at the 1956 Summer Olympics in Melbourne, Australia. Four years later he once again competed in the Olympics for his native country.
